rounds.response:

- Coverage risk: If the Q2 +3ppt exit rate persists into next quarter, expect an approximate 4–6% effective capacity shortfall across Manila + Kraków (assumes ~70% of exits are frontline and ~6–8 week recruit-to-ready lag), with pressure concentrated in peak shifts.
